title: Dual-style viral motivational short · one topic, one voice, two films
goal: Choose one high-FOMO motivational idea for a Desi audience, create one emotionally human 60–90 second easy-Urdunglish master script and voice-over, then produce two premium 16:9 landscape videos from that same narrative using the permanent WF-01 and WF-03 style workflows.
acceptance_criteria: One original motivational topic and one shared retention-engineered 60–90 second easy-Urdunglish script with curiosity, FOMO, emotional storytelling, relatability, and a human tone.
One user-approved professional voice artist and mastered voice-over used consistently across both edits.
Two complete 16:9 landscape videos at 1920×1080: one in styles/monarch-stickman-animation and one in styles/monarch-noir-film.
Every beat receives intentional premium visuals, animation, typography, colour, SFX/ASMR and music design while preserving intelligibility and avoiding omissions.
Outputs are objectively validated, documented with provenance, and promoted into both permanent style packages before active-task archival.
